content:
Apple TV currently boasts a strong lineup, headlined by 《Slow Horses》, 《Ted Lasso》, 《Dark Matter》, and Matthew McConaughey's new series 《Brothers》. But there's more to come — here's everything premiering on Apple TV in October.

《The Last First: Winter K2》

  • Release date: October 2
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Documentary

Directed by Amir Bar-Lev, 《The Last First: Winter K2》 tells a complex, thrilling, and moving story that examines the extreme mountaineering industry and its ever-changing culture. The film focuses on a 2021 expedition featuring Icelandic mountaineer John Snorri Sigurjónsson and Pakistani father-and-son duo Ali and Sajid Sadpara, aiming to become the first team to summit K2 in winter — when conditions on the mountain are at their most brutal. They soon discover that the same treacherous route is shared with influencer climbers and their film crews, commercial climbing clients, and renowned Nepalese mountaineer Nims along with his team of Sherpas. 《The Last First: Winter K2》 takes audiences to the icy heights of K2, where unpredictable weather reveals an unexpected, layered story — weaving together strategy and determination, class and hierarchy, wealth and power — all unfolding in a life-or-death environment.

《The Sisters Grimm》 (Season 2)

  • Release date: October 2
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Kids and Family

Two orphaned sisters navigate a town full of fairy tale characters, encountering all manner of heroes and villains as they investigate the mystery of their missing parents. Blending exploration, fantasy, and adventure, 《The Sisters Grimm》 explores important themes suitable for all ages.

《Small Prophets》

  • Release date: October 7
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Comedy

《Small Prophets》 is a comedy about the eccentric Michael Sleep (Pearce Quigley). Since the disappearance of his beloved Clea seven years ago, he's been living an ordinary life — working at a hardware store, visiting his father Brian (Sir Michael Palin), and hoping Clea will return. One day, Brian shares with him an ancient recipe with ingredients including rainwater, horse manure, and a touch of alchemy. Armed with the recipe, Michael sets out — somewhat sceptically — to create homunculi: magical spirits capable of predicting the future, hoping they'll answer his biggest question: "Will I ever see Clea again?"

《Matchbox: The Movie》

  • Release date: October 9
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Action

Based on the classic Mattel toy, 《Matchbox: The Movie》 is an action-packed, globe-trotting adventure about a group of lifelong friends whose lives are disrupted when CIA undercover agent Sean (John Cena) — their long-lost former leader — returns to their small town, accidentally pulling them into a high-stakes international chase to save the world.

《Tenzing》

  • Release date: October 16
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Drama

Based on a true story, 《Tenzing》 recounts the little-known tale of Tenzing Norgay (Genden Phuntsok) — a brilliant Himalayan mountaineer who, alongside New Zealand climber Edmund Hillary (Tom Hiddleston), became one of the first to reach the summit of Everest. Encouraged by his wife Dawa (Thinley Lhamo) and supported by expedition secretary Jill Henderson (Caitríona Balfe), they convince Colonel John Hunt (Willem Dafoe) that Tenzing deserves to be a full member of the British climbing team, not merely a support role. To Western climbers, "Everest" is a peak waiting to be conquered; to Tenzing, "Chomolungma" is the sacred Goddess Mother of the World. The journey that follows is riven by tensions of background, class, and ambition, and fraught with the mountain's own dangers. But at the top of the world, empires, status, and ambition melt away, leaving only two outsiders bound by mutual respect and trust — and for Tenzing, the realisation of a lifelong dream and a spiritual calling.

《Where's Wanda?》 (Season 2)

  • Release date: October 21
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Dark Comedy

Apple's first German-language series, 《Where's Wanda?》, is a dark comedy about parents Dedo and Carlotta Klatt who are desperately searching for their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda — who vanished without warning months ago. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, acquiring listening devices with help from their tech-savvy son Ole. Posing as utility company workers, they install bugs across the neighbourhood and half the community, only to discover that behind closed doors, none of their neighbours are who they seem.

《Nocturne》

  • Release date: October 30
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Crime Drama

The series tells the story of Jonah Lynn (Liev Schreiber) — a veteran turned homicide detective, worn out from the hard streets of Philadelphia, who moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania seeking a quieter life. But when the town and his family come under attack from the cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (Graham), Jonah must protect everything he holds dear. When a desperate search for Jurek's final missing victim forces Jonah to send his stepdaughter — FBI agent Saga Bauer (Beetz) — after Jurek, just how much is Jonah willing to sacrifice?

New episodes: 《Slow Horses》, 《Brothers》 and more

Apple TV will also release new episodes of several currently airing series in October, including:

  • 《Ted Lasso》: the Jason Sudeikis-led comedy, airing through October 7
  • 《Last Seen》: a crime thriller, airing through October 7
  • 《Slow Horses》: the acclaimed British spy drama, airing through October 21
  • 《Dark Matter》: the sci-fi series starring Joel Edgerton, airing through October 30
  • 《Brothers》: the comedy co-starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, airing through November 4

Which Apple TV October release are you planning to watch? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs USD 14.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle for a discounted rate.
